title: MaleTheme Duo #024 · 남 V자 보디빌더·플럼 스모키·소방관 테마·투톤 / 남 피트니스 모델·그래픽 블랙·군인 테마
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright spring garden terrace of pale stone with blooming tulip beds, a low trimmed hedge, a standard-height garden gate and a bench, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Ethiopian man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a pretty androgynous idol face with large doe eyes, a small chin and a soft jaw, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth medium-brown skin with a warm red undertone, a relaxed easygoing look with a faint smile, vivid copper-orange hair styled in cornrows braided tight against the scalp, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (an iron hammer head, a gold square-sided cowbell, an iron pyramid-shaped lump), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and two to three mixed-metal anklets. Extremely long almond nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a red-and-yellow firefighter helmet with a clear visor pushed up, yellow reflective-striped suspenders running over his bare shoulders and chest, and a minimal glossy red and white two-tone T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel and a yellow reflective stripe, on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him.
LEFT Pose: square to camera, feet wide, arms clear of his body.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme black platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Jamaican man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, sharp black graphic eyeliner with matte nude lips and defined contour, smooth deep caramel-brown skin, a confident smirk, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in wavy, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large platinum hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a gold hammer head, a copper ship's anchor, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single rose-gold anklet. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a tilted olive-green military beret with a brass badge, two silver dog-tag chains hanging on his bare chest, and a minimal camouflage-pattern T-back thong with one tiny opaque front panel on thin side strings tied high at the hips and a single thin strap down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his chest and stomach bare.
RIGHT Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on his hip.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue chunky platform boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 4:5 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
